Reflection:
The Thunderbird compose window is open with the “Attach” button at position (891, 168). To attach the AWS bill located at ~/aws-bill.pdf, I will click that button, open the file picker, focus the location bar, type the path, and confirm.

```python
import pyautogui, time

# Click the "Attach" button
pyautogui.click(940, 180)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Focus the location bar in the file chooser
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'l')
time.sleep(0.2)

# Enter the path to the AWS bill and confirm
pyautogui.typewrite('~/aws-bill.pdf')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.5)
```
